mapper.sql: select a.agent_id, a.user_id, a.nick_name, a.status, a.max_sessions, a.active_sessions, a.sort_order, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, u.user_name from mall_chat_agent a left join sys_user u on a.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select:
a.del_flag = '0' AND a.nick_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%') AND a.status = #{status}
order by a.sort_order asc, a.agent_id asc
where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '1' and a.active_sessions < a.max_sessions order by a.active_sessions asc, a.sort_order asc, a.agent_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_chat_agent (user_id, nick_name, status, max_sessions, active_sessions, sort_order, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{nickName}, #{status}, #{maxSessions}, 0, #{sortOrder}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update mall_chat_agent set del_flag = '2' where agent_id = #{agentId}
update mall_chat_agent set active_sessions = active_sessions + 1 where agent_id = #{agentId} and del_flag = '0'
update mall_chat_agent set active_sessions = case when active_sessions > 0 then active_sessions - 1 else 0 end where agent_id = #{agentId} and del_flag = '0'
